[[Category:State]]
A '''state''' is a [[formal institution]] that exercises power over

* a permanent population
* an exclusive territory (i.e., territory of a state cannot be simultaneously territory of another state)

<ref>{{#cite:Q4052}}</ref>

== Organisation ==

== Rule of law ==

Many modern states are organised by the '''rule of law''', which means the state's institutions (the '''government''') is organised according to legal rules set out in a [[constitution]].<ref>{{#cite:Q3952}}</ref>

== Division of power ==

A state may be categorised as

* an [[absolute monarchy]], if one person detains the ultimate power of the state and pass it down to their offsprings;
* a [[constitutional monarchy]], in which the head of state is similarly hereditary as in an absolute monarchy, but the monarch's power is limited by a [[constitution]];
* an [[oligarchy]], if a few families exercice effective control over a state's institutions
* a [[dictatorship]],if one or few people detain the ultimate power of the state
* a [[republic]], if the power of the state is detained by its '''[[citizens]]''', and exercised via [[election|democratically elected representatives]]
* ...

Some states possesses characteristics of more than one form. They are then said to be a '''mixed state'''.
